Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 General Information
 We are looking for a motivated Software Development Intern to join our international team and help develop applications for advanced Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) solutions that support engineers throughout the product-development process
In this role, you will work closely with software developers and mechanical engineers to implement, test, and improve software functionality. You will gain practical experience in object-oriented programming, software testing, version control in an Agile development environment .
This is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience in professional software development while contributing to engineering tools used in real-world applications.
 Your Key Responsibilities
Develop and improve software components for CAE applications.
Implement engineering methods and calculations in software.
Work with object-oriented programming, preferably using C++ or C#.
Write clean, structured, and maintainable code.
Create and execute software tests.
Analyze test results and help resolve software issues.
Support debugging and troubleshooting activities.
Work with requirements and translate them into software solutions.
Document code, functionality, test cases, and technical decisions.
Use version-control systems such as GitHub.
Track tasks and issues using tools such as Jira.
Participate in Agile development activities, team meetings, and reviews.
Collaborate with software developers, mechanical engineers, and other stakeholders.
Support the delivery of reliable and user-friendly engineering applications.
 Your Qualifications
Computer Science or a related field.
Basic programming experience in one or more languages.
Interest in object-oriented programming and software development.
Initial experience with C++ or C# is an advantage.
Basic understanding of software testing and debugging.
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, or similar version-control tools is a plus.
Familiarity with Jira or Agile software development is an advantage.
Interest in mechanical engineering, CAE, or engineering applications.
Structured and analytical working style.
Willingness to learn and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
Good English communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in an international team.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and through referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
